messages:
nina: Postmortem follow-up: capturing owners for rollout/canary improvements after the outage. Goal: reduce blast radius, make auto-rollback deterministic.

carlos: I'll own rollout API changes to support region-scoped flags and emergency_kill. ETA: 2026-02-02.

mei: I'll do canary sampling fix and add canary backoff logic. Plan: sample -> 0.1% while we patch. ETA: 48h.

dan: I'll implement rollback policy with grace windows: require 2/3 evals before triggering, plus a cooldown after rollback (30m). ETA: 2026-01-20.

nina: Suggested thresholds: soft alert = 20% error increase over baseline for 15m; hard rollback = 50% increase OR 3x p95 latency for 10m. Thoughts?

carlos: add manual pause toggle in console to avoid auto-rollback during scheduled infra work.

mei: test plan will include synthetic regional traffic and chaos rollback scenarios.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: rollout-policy feature branch created at 09:12 UTC.

nina: Action items summary:
- mei: canary sampling + tests -> ticket TEST-330 -> ETA 2026-01-18
- carlos: region-scoped flags + emergency_kill -> ticket INF-5300 -> ETA 2026-02-02
- dan: rollback policy + cooldown -> ticket OPS-945 -> ETA 2026-01-20
- nina: add recurring 2-week regression audit -> owner nina -> cadence: bi-weekly

carlos: I'll add RFC and PR links to the tickets. Please react :thumbsup: if okay.
